publications.title: Understanding and Mitigating Inference-Time Overreliance Using Agentic Memory
publications.summary: Retrieved memories can distort an agent's inference even when they are benign, correctly stored and appropriately retrieved. We name this memory over-reliance and show it is strongest under partial query-memory overlap. MEMTRIM indexes evidence at write time and controls its reuse at read time, cutting over-reliance while keeping the benefits of useful memory.
